# Temp variable mdr_moon_done: the module just finished.
mdr_moon_apply = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_hab = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_cap = 8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_greenhouse = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_greenhouse = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_drill = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_mine = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_lab = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_workshop = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_workshop = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_medical = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 7 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_quarters = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_cap = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 8 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_solar = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 9 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_reactor = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_reactor = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 10 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_moxie = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_done = 11 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_n_fuel = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_sm_olv_c = -0.03 }
	}
}

# Country scope, weekly, with a Mars colony.
mdr_moon_weekly = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_speed = mdr_space_engineers }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_speed = 2000 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_speed = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_moon_jobs = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s1_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_moon_s1_left = mdr_moon_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s1_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s1 = mdr_moon_s1_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_done = mdr_moon_s1_job }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s1_job = 0 }
			mdr_moon_apply = yes
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s2_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_moon_s2_left = mdr_moon_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s2_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s2 = mdr_moon_s2_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_done = mdr_moon_s2_job }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s2_job = 0 }
			mdr_moon_apply = yes
		}

		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_moon_s9_left = mdr_moon_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s9_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s9 = mdr_moon_s9_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_done = mdr_moon_s9_job }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s9_job = 0 }
			mdr_moon_apply = yes
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s10_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_moon_s10_left = mdr_moon_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s10_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s10 = mdr_moon_s10_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_done = mdr_moon_s10_job }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s10_job = 0 }
			mdr_moon_apply = yes
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s4_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_moon_s4_left = mdr_moon_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s4_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s4 = mdr_moon_s4_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_done = mdr_moon_s4_job }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s4_job = 0 }
			mdr_moon_apply = yes
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s12_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_moon_s12_left = mdr_moon_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_s12_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s12 = mdr_moon_s12_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_done = mdr_moon_s12_job }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_s12_job = 0 }
			mdr_moon_apply = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_made = mdr_moon_n_solar }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_made = 1.0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy = mdr_moon_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_made = mdr_moon_n_moxie }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_made = 1.0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen = mdr_moon_made }
	set_variable = { mdr_moon_science = mdr_moon_n_lab }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_moon_science = 0.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = mdr_moon_science }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_cheer = mdr_moon_n_medical }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_cheer = 1.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_cheer2 = mdr_moon_n_quarters }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_cheer2 = 0.5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_cheer = mdr_moon_cheer2 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale = mdr_moon_cheer }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale = 100 } }
	mdr_moon_figures = yes
}

	add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_built = mdr_moon_n_hab }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_built = mdr_moon_n_greenhouse }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_built = mdr_moon_n_drill }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_built = mdr_moon_n_lab }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_built = mdr_moon_n_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_built = mdr_moon_n_medical }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_built = mdr_moon_n_quarters }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_moon_built = mdr_moon_n_solar }

}

mdr_moon_next = {

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 2 } } set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 3 } } set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 6 } } set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 7 } } set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 8 } } set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 11 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 11 } } set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = 8 } }

}

# Automatic mode and AI: builds what the colony lacks most, one work at a time, keeping the reserve.
mdr_moon_auto = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_jobs < 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_want_l = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_room = mdr_col_moon_cap }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_room = -4 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_lifesupport } set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_want_l = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_lunarice } set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_want_l = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale < 50 } has_tech = mdr_sp_deepmission } set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_want_l = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_col_moon_pop compare = greater_than_or_equals value = mdr_moon_room } always = yes } set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_want_l = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_want_s = 8 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_regolith } set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_want_s = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_fission } set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_want_s = 9 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_1_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 1 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_2_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 2 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_5_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 5 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_7_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 7 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_13_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 13 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_6_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 6 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_8_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 8 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_11_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 11 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_14_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 14 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_9_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 9 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_10_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 10 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_4_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 4 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 0 } mdr_moon_slot_12_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_sel = 12 }
			set_variable = { mdr_moon_view = mdr_moon_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_moon_can_build = yes } mdr_moon_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_moon_started = 1 } }
		}
	}
}
# Generated by herramientas/space_colony.py. Mars colony: mdr_mars_s<slot> is the module built there (0: none),
# mdr_mars_s<slot>_job the one being built and mdr_mars_s<slot>_left its weeks. mdr_mars_n_<module> counts them.

# When the Martian base is founded: the first habitat already stands on slot 1.
mdr_mars_start = {
	set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_mars_n_hab = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 1 }
}

mdr_mars_build = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_job = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_left = 20 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1.8 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_job = 2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_left = 26 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2.6 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_job = 3 }
		set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_left = 22 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2.2 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 4 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_job = 4 }
		set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_left = 28 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -3.1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}

# Temp variable mdr_mars_done: the module just finished.
mdr_mars_apply = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_hab = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_cap = 8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_greenhouse = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_greenhouse = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_drill = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_mine = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_lab = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_workshop = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_workshop = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_medical = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 7 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_quarters = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_cap = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 8 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_solar = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 9 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_reactor = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_reactor = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 10 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_moxie = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_done = 11 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_n_fuel = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_sm_olv_c = -0.03 }
	}
}

# Country scope, weekly, with a Mars colony.
mdr_mars_weekly = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_speed = mdr_space_engineers }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_speed = 2000 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_speed = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_mars_jobs = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_left = mdr_mars_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1 = mdr_mars_s1_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_done = mdr_mars_s1_job }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_s1_job = 0 }
			mdr_mars_apply = yes
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_s2_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_mars_s2_left = mdr_mars_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_s2_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_s2 = mdr_mars_s2_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_done = mdr_mars_s2_job }

		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_made = mdr_mars_n_solar }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_made = 0.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_energy = mdr_mars_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_made = mdr_mars_n_moxie }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_made = 1.0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_oxygen = mdr_mars_made }
	set_variable = { mdr_mars_science = mdr_mars_n_lab }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_mars_science = 0.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = mdr_mars_science }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_cheer = mdr_mars_n_medical }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_cheer = 1.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_cheer2 = mdr_mars_n_quarters }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_cheer2 = 0.5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_cheer = mdr_mars_cheer2 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_morale = mdr_mars_cheer }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mars_morale > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_mars_morale = 100 } }
	mdr_mars_figures = yes
}

mdr_mars_figures = {
	set_variable = { mdr_mars_built = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_hab }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_greenhouse }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_drill }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_lab }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_medical }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_quarters }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_solar }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_reactor }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_moxie }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_built = mdr_mars_n_fuel }
	set_variable = { mdr_mars_science_total = mdr_col_mars_pop }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_mars_science_total = 0.09 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_lab_science = mdr_mars_n_lab }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_lab_science = 0.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mars_science_total = mdr_mars_lab_science }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_made = mdr_mars_n_solar }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_made = 0.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_energy_net = mdr_mars_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_made = mdr_mars_n_moxie }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_made = 1.0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mars_oxygen_net = mdr_mars_made }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

mdr_mars_next = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 2 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 3 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 6 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 7 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 8 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 11 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 11 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 8 } }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 3 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 6 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 5 } }

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 8 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 11 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = 9 } }

	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

# Automatic mode and AI: builds what the colony lacks most, one work at a time, keeping the reserve.
mdr_mars_auto = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_jobs < 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_want_l = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_room = mdr_col_mars_cap }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_room = -4 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mars_food < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_lifesupport } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_want_l = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mars_water < 40 } always = yes } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_want_l = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mars_morale < 50 } has_tech = mdr_sp_deepmission } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_want_l = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_col_mars_pop compare = greater_than_or_equals value = mdr_mars_room } always = yes } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_want_l = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_want_s = 8 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mars_oxygen < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_regolith } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_want_s = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mars_energy < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_fission } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_want_s = 9 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_1_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 1 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_2_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 2 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_5_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 5 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_7_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 7 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_13_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 13 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_6_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 6 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_8_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 8 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_11_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 11 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_14_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 14 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_9_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 9 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_10_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 10 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_4_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 4 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 0 } mdr_mars_slot_12_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_sel = 12 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mars_view = mdr_mars_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mars_can_build = yes } mdr_mars_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mars_started = 1 } }
		}
	}
}
# Generated by herramientas/space_colony.py. Mars colony: mdr_venus_s<slot> is the module built there (0: none),
# mdr_venus_s<slot>_job the one being built and mdr_venus_s<slot>_left its weeks. mdr_venus_n_<module> counts them.

# When the Martian base is founded: the first habitat already stands on slot 1.
mdr_venus_start = {
	set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_venus_n_hab = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 1 }
}

mdr_venus_build = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_left = 21 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2.1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job = 2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_left = 27 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -3.0 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job = 3 }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_left = 23 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2.5 }

		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -3.6 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 5 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job = 5 }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_left = 32 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -3.9 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 6 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job = 6 }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_left = 25 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2.8 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 7 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job = 7 }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_left = 34 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -4.4 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 8 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job = 8 }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_left = 13 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1.4 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 9 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job = 9 }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_left = 25 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -3.3 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 10 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job = 10 }

# Temp variable mdr_venus_done: the module just finished.
mdr_venus_apply = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_hab = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_cap = 8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_greenhouse = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_greenhouse = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_drill = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_mine = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_lab = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_workshop = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_workshop = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_medical = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 7 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_quarters = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_cap = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 8 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_solar = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 9 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_reactor = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_reactor = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 10 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_moxie = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_done = 11 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_n_fuel = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_sm_olv_c = -0.03 }
	}
}

# Country scope, weekly, with a Mars colony.
mdr_venus_weekly = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_speed = mdr_space_engineers }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_speed = 2000 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_speed = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_venus_jobs = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_left = mdr_venus_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1 = mdr_venus_s1_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_done = mdr_venus_s1_job }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_s1_job = 0 }

		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_s2_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_jobs = 1 }

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_s2_left < 0.01 } }

		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_made = mdr_venus_n_solar }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_made = 1.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy = mdr_venus_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_made = mdr_venus_n_moxie }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_made = 1.0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen = mdr_venus_made }
	set_variable = { mdr_venus_science = mdr_venus_n_lab }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_venus_science = 0.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = mdr_venus_science }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_cheer = mdr_venus_n_medical }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_cheer = 1.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_cheer2 = mdr_venus_n_quarters }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_cheer2 = 0.5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_cheer = mdr_venus_cheer2 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_morale = mdr_venus_cheer }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_morale > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_morale = 100 } }
	mdr_venus_figures = yes
}

mdr_venus_figures = {
	set_variable = { mdr_venus_built = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_hab }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_greenhouse }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_drill }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_lab }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_medical }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_quarters }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_solar }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_reactor }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_moxie }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_built = mdr_venus_n_fuel }
	set_variable = { mdr_venus_science_total = mdr_col_venus_pop }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_venus_science_total = 0.09 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_lab_science = mdr_venus_n_lab }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_lab_science = 0.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_venus_science_total = mdr_venus_lab_science }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_made = mdr_venus_n_solar }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_made = 1.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy_net = mdr_venus_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_made = mdr_venus_n_moxie }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_made = 1.0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen_net = mdr_venus_made }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

mdr_venus_select = {

		set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 1 }

mdr_venus_next = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 2 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 3 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 6 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 7 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 8 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 11 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 11 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 8 } }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

mdr_venus_prev = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 2 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 3 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 6 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 7 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 8 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 11 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 11 } } set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = 10 } }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

# Automatic mode and AI: builds what the colony lacks most, one work at a time, keeping the reserve.
mdr_venus_auto = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_jobs < 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_want_l = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_room = mdr_col_venus_cap }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_room = -4 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_lifesupport } set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_want_l = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_venusfloat } set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_want_l = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_morale < 50 } has_tech = mdr_sp_deepmission } set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_want_l = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_col_venus_pop compare = greater_than_or_equals value = mdr_venus_room } always = yes } set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_want_l = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_want_s = 8 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_regolith } set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_want_s = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_fission } set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_want_s = 9 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_1_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 1 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_2_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 2 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_5_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 5 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_7_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 7 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_13_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 13 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_6_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 6 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_8_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 8 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_11_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 11 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_14_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 14 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_9_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 9 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_10_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 10 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_4_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 4 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 0 } mdr_venus_slot_12_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_sel = 12 }
			set_variable = { mdr_venus_view = mdr_venus_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_venus_can_build = yes } mdr_venus_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_venus_started = 1 } }
		}
	}
}
# Generated by herramientas/space_colony.py. Mars colony: mdr_mercury_s<slot> is the module built there (0: none),
# mdr_mercury_s<slot>_job the one being built and mdr_mercury_s<slot>_left its weeks. mdr_mercury_n_<module> counts them.

# When the Martian base is founded: the first habitat already stands on slot 1.
mdr_mercury_start = {
	set_variable = { mdr_mercury_s1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_hab = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 1 }
}

mdr_mercury_build = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_mercury_s1_job = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_mercury_s1_left = 23 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2.3 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_mercury_s1_job = 2 }

# Temp variable mdr_mercury_done: the module just finished.
mdr_mercury_apply = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_hab = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_cap = 8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_greenhouse = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_greenhouse = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_drill = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_mine = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_lab = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_workshop = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_workshop = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_medical = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 7 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_quarters = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_cap = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 8 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_solar = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 9 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_reactor = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_reactor = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 10 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_moxie = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = 11 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_n_fuel = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_sm_olv_c = -0.03 }
	}
}

# Country scope, weekly, with a Mars colony.
mdr_mercury_weekly = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_speed = mdr_space_engineers }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_speed = 2000 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_speed = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_mercury_jobs = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_s1_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_mercury_s1_left = mdr_mercury_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_s1_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_s1 = mdr_mercury_s1_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = mdr_mercury_s1_job }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_s1_job = 0 }
			mdr_mercury_apply = yes
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_s2_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_mercury_s2_left = mdr_mercury_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_s2_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_s2 = mdr_mercury_s2_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_done = mdr_mercury_s2_job }

			mdr_mercury_apply = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_made = mdr_mercury_n_solar }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_made = 2.2 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_energy = mdr_mercury_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_made = mdr_mercury_n_moxie }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_made = 1.0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_oxygen = mdr_mercury_made }
	set_variable = { mdr_mercury_science = mdr_mercury_n_lab }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_mercury_science = 0.6 }

	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_cheer = mdr_mercury_n_medical }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_cheer = 1.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_cheer2 = mdr_mercury_n_quarters }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_cheer2 = 0.5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_cheer = mdr_mercury_cheer2 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_morale = mdr_mercury_cheer }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_morale > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_morale = 100 } }
	mdr_mercury_figures = yes
}

mdr_mercury_figures = {
	set_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_hab }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_greenhouse }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_drill }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_lab }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_medical }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_quarters }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_solar }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_reactor }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_moxie }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_built = mdr_mercury_n_fuel }
	set_variable = { mdr_mercury_science_total = mdr_col_mercury_pop }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_mercury_science_total = 0.09 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_lab_science = mdr_mercury_n_lab }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_lab_science = 0.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_mercury_science_total = mdr_mercury_lab_science }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_made = mdr_mercury_n_solar }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_made = 2.2 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_energy_net = mdr_mercury_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_made = mdr_mercury_n_moxie }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_made = 1.0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_oxygen_net = mdr_mercury_made }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

mdr_mercury_next = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 2 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 3 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 6 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 7 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 8 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 11 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 11 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 8 } }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

mdr_mercury_prev = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 2 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 3 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 6 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 7 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 8 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 11 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 11 } } set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = 10 } }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

# Automatic mode and AI: builds what the colony lacks most, one work at a time, keeping the reserve.
mdr_mercury_auto = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_jobs < 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_want_l = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_room = mdr_col_mercury_cap }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_room = -4 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_food < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_lifesupport } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_want_l = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_water < 40 } always = yes } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_want_l = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_morale < 50 } has_tech = mdr_sp_deepmission } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_want_l = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_col_mercury_pop compare = greater_than_or_equals value = mdr_mercury_room } always = yes } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_want_l = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_want_s = 8 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_oxygen < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_regolith } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_want_s = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_energy < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_fission } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_want_s = 9 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_1_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 1 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_2_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 2 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_5_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 5 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_7_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 7 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_13_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 13 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_6_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 6 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_8_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 8 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_11_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 11 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_14_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 14 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_9_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 9 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_10_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 10 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_4_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 4 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 0 } mdr_mercury_slot_12_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_sel = 12 }
			set_variable = { mdr_mercury_view = mdr_mercury_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_mercury_can_build = yes } mdr_mercury_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_mercury_started = 1 } }
		}
	}
}
# Generated by herramientas/space_colony.py. Mars colony: mdr_asteroids_s<slot> is the module built there (0: none),
# mdr_asteroids_s<slot>_job the one being built and mdr_asteroids_s<slot>_left its weeks. mdr_asteroids_n_<module> counts them.

# When the Martian base is founded: the first habitat already stands on slot 1.
mdr_asteroids_start = {
	set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_hab = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 1 }
}

mdr_asteroids_build = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1_job = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1_left = 20 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1.9 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1_job = 2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1_left = 26 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2.7 }

# Temp variable mdr_asteroids_done: the module just finished.
mdr_asteroids_apply = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_hab = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_cap = 8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_greenhouse = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_greenhouse = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_drill = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_mine = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_lab = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_workshop = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_workshop = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_medical = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 7 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_quarters = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_cap = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 8 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_solar = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 9 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_reactor = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_reactor = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 10 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_moxie = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_done = 11 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_n_fuel = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_sm_olv_c = -0.03 }
	}
}

# Country scope, weekly, with a Mars colony.
mdr_asteroids_weekly = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_speed = mdr_space_engineers }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_speed = 2000 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_speed = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_jobs = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1_left = mdr_asteroids_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1 = mdr_asteroids_s1_job }

		}
	}

}

mdr_asteroids_figures = {
	set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_hab }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_greenhouse }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_drill }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_lab }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_medical }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_quarters }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_solar }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_reactor }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_moxie }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_built = mdr_asteroids_n_fuel }
	set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_science_total = mdr_col_asteroids_pop }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_asteroids_science_total = 0.09 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_lab_science = mdr_asteroids_n_lab }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_lab_science = 0.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_asteroids_science_total = mdr_asteroids_lab_science }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_made = mdr_asteroids_n_solar }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_made = 0.4 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_energy_net = mdr_asteroids_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_made = mdr_asteroids_n_moxie }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_made = 1.0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_oxygen_net = mdr_asteroids_made }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

mdr_asteroids_select = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1 > 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_s1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_s1_job > 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_s1_job } }
	}

mdr_asteroids_next = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 2 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 3 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 6 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 7 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 8 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 11 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 11 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 8 } }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

mdr_asteroids_prev = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 2 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 3 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 6 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 7 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 8 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 11 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 11 } } set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = 10 } }
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

# Automatic mode and AI: builds what the colony lacks most, one work at a time, keeping the reserve.
mdr_asteroids_auto = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_jobs < 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_want_l = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_room = mdr_col_asteroids_cap }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_room = -4 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_food < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_lifesupport } set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_want_l = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_water < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_asteroidmining } set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_want_l = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_morale < 50 } has_tech = mdr_sp_deepmission } set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_want_l = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_col_asteroids_pop compare = greater_than_or_equals value = mdr_asteroids_room } always = yes } set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_want_l = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_want_s = 8 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_oxygen < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_regolith } set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_want_s = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_asteroids_energy < 40 } has_tech = mdr_sp_fission } set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_want_s = 9 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_1_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 1 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_2_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 2 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_5_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 5 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_7_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 7 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_13_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 13 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_6_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 6 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_8_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 8 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_11_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 11 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_14_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 14 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_9_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 9 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_10_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 10 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_l }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_4_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 4 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 0 } mdr_asteroids_slot_12_free = yes }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_sel = 12 }
			set_variable = { mdr_asteroids_view = mdr_asteroids_want_s }
			if = { limit = { mdr_asteroids_can_build = yes } mdr_asteroids_build = yes set_temp_variable = { mdr_asteroids_started = 1 } }
		}
	}
}
# Generated by herramientas/space_colony.py. Mars colony: mdr_callisto_s<slot> is the module built there (0: none),
# mdr_callisto_s<slot>_job the one being built and mdr_callisto_s<slot>_left its weeks. mdr_callisto_n_<module> counts them.

# When the Martian base is founded: the first habitat already stands on slot 1.
mdr_callisto_start = {
	set_variable = { mdr_callisto_s1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_hab = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_callisto_sel = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_callisto_view = 1 }
}

mdr_callisto_build = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_callisto_view = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_callisto_s1_job = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_callisto_s1_left = 27 }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -3.1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_callisto_view = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_callisto_s1_job = 2 }

# Temp variable mdr_callisto_done: the module just finished.
mdr_callisto_apply = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_hab = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_cap = 8 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_greenhouse = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_greenhouse = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_drill = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_mine = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_lab = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_workshop = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_workshop = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_medical = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 7 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_quarters = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_cap = 12 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 8 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_solar = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 9 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_reactor = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_reactor = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 10 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_moxie = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = 11 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_n_fuel = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_sm_olv_c = -0.03 }
	}
}

# Country scope, weekly, with a Mars colony.
mdr_callisto_weekly = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_callisto_speed = mdr_space_engineers }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdr_callisto_speed = 2000 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_callisto_speed = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_callisto_jobs = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_s1_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_callisto_s1_left = mdr_callisto_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_s1_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_callisto_s1 = mdr_callisto_s1_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = mdr_callisto_s1_job }
			set_variable = { mdr_callisto_s1_job = 0 }
			mdr_callisto_apply = yes
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_s2_job > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_callisto_jobs = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdr_callisto_s2_left = mdr_callisto_speed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_callisto_s2_left < 0.01 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_callisto_s2 = mdr_callisto_s2_job }
			set_temp_variable = { mdr_callisto_done = mdr_callisto_s2_job }

	set_variable = { mdr_callisto_science = mdr_callisto_n_lab }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_callisto_science = 0.6 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = mdr_callisto_science }

	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_callisto_cheer = 1.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_callisto_cheer2 = mdr_callisto_n_quarters }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_callisto_cheer2 = 0.5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_callisto_cheer = mdr_callisto_cheer2 }
